downloads.name: Downloads
downloads.no_access: Disk Cleaner can't read Downloads yet. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders › Disk Cleaner › Downloads Folder, then rescan.
downloads.mounted: This disk image is mounted. Eject it in Finder first.
downloads.installers.title: Installers
downloads.installers.what: Disk images and packages (.dmg, .pkg) you downloaded to install apps.
downloads.installers.why: Once an app is installed, its installer isn't needed; it can be downloaded again from the developer's site. Mounted images can't be selected.
downloads.installers.after: Files are moved to the Trash, so you can still bring them back. Space is freed when you empty the Trash.
downloads.builds.title: App builds
downloads.builds.what: Builds of apps: .aab and .apk for Google Play, .ipa and .xcarchive for the App Store, .app bundles.
downloads.builds.why: A build that is already uploaded to the store is kept there, and every build can be made again from the project.
downloads.builds.after: Files are moved to the Trash. Keep builds you still have to upload, and .xcarchive of versions that are live in the App Store.
downloads.archives.title: Archives
downloads.archives.why: Usually an archive has already been unpacked or its contents installed.
downloads.archives.after: Files are moved to the Trash. Check that you don't keep the only copy of something inside.
